description: This is a PHP unit test class for the RecruitmentAttachmentDao, testing CRUD operations related to recruitment vacancy attachments in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the RecruitmentAttachmentDao's methods related to recruitment attachment management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new RecruitmentAttachmentDao and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testSaveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new vacancy attachment and checks if the returned object has expected properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentContentById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a vacancy attachment by ID and its properties.

methods.name: testGetVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Checks fetching multiple attachments for a vacancy ID and their attributes.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple attachments and confirms they are removed.
